theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hc : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
  have hn : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by ext x; simp
    exact (hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc) (this ▸ Finset.notMem_empty)
  let Q := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P
  have hcard : P.card = Q.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ) <;> simp_all [Q, hc, hn]
  have hsum : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← Finset.card_add_of_disjoint]
    · simp [Q, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
    · simp [Q]
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card S := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr inferInstance
  omega
